    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.accessibility.Accessible, javax.swing.RootPaneContainer, javax.swing.WindowConstants

    public class BrickBreaker
extends Game
    Date: 23/1/2023 Teacher: Mr. Benum Class: ICS4U1
    Version:
    Code description: Welcome to Carson's edition of Atari Breakout, Prison Break! This code is a rendition of the beloved arcade classic, with additional touches such as cutscenes. Players are expected to navigate through each level by destroying all of the bricks on the screen with their player controlled ball. Don't let the ball touch the floor, or else you lose! However, your high scores will still live on. If any external research is conducted, the source is cited on top of the individual blocks of code. Image sources: https://pixeljoint.com/pixelart/78143.htm https://www.vecteezy.com/vector-art/5450186-hand-gesture-pixel-art https://twitter.com/neonslice/status/1412534981352738822 ImageIcon resource: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/21129329/load-png-as-sprite-java Jlabel resource: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/58613074/problem-reading-font-data-error-when-trying-to-load-a-ttf-file-into-my-game JLabel resource: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5652344/how-can-i-use-a-custom-font-in-java Filewriting resource: https://www.w3schools.com/java/java_files_create.asp Filewriting resource: https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials/java-write-to-file JOptionPane resource: https://mkyong.com/swing/java-swing-joptionpane-showoptiondialog-example/+

    349930594
